programs.title: HER Women in Asia
programs.desc: Reduce, reuse and recycle — to live a waste free life is the goal of more and more  people around the world. But where to start? HER introduces women with creative and innovative ideas on how to consume less and recycle more. And sometimes it's also, about showing that even waste can be turned into something wonderful.

programs.title: Tomorrow Today
programs.desc: High-speed X-rays let researchers see exactly what happens during a collision. Also on the show: plastic-eating worms, a sailboat for ocean research, and why women in soccer run farther and play harder than men.

programs.title: DW News Focus
programs.desc: Our deep dive format explains the stories that matter - with clarity, context and journalistic rigor. Each segment goes beyond the headlines to uncover what's driving key developments around the world, featuring sharp analysis, expert voices and exclusive on the ground insights from where events are unfolding.

programs.title: Shift
programs.desc: Digital technology unlocks new ways to explore history through VR, AR and games — but social media can oversimplify or distort facts.

programs.title: REV
programs.desc: US carmakers pivot back to combustion engines under Donald Trump, while China pulls ahead in electric mobility. A strategic misstep? And: electric ferries in Lagos, transport woes in Karachi and German firms in Serbia.
